answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Registered vehicle inspector report with vehicle standards verification, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 679 aliases would need 679 separate proofs, each costing about 116 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the vault of the check, count the orchard of the cost, and read the delta of the history before any answer is graded. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
